about: “Your life, drawn as a map you walk through.” A calm photo diary, walking map and weather town in one app.

features.title: A diorama for every day
features.body: Each day becomes a card lit by that day's weather.

features.title: Photo diary
features.body: One calm entry a day, with your photos.

features.title: Walking map
features.body: Your days drawn as a map you can walk back through.

features.title: Runs anywhere
features.body: Open it in any browser; add it to the home screen and it works offline after the first visit.

features.title: Your diary stays on your device
features.body: Each device keeps its own diary, and you can move it with a backup from Settings.
